# UpCounsel

> UpCounsel connects businesses with vetted attorneys for on-demand legal services, documents, and expert counsel across multiple practice areas.

UpCounsel is a legal services platform that provides access to a network of experienced attorneys for business law, intellectual property, labor and employment matters, and legal document preparation. The platform serves Fortune 1000 companies and smaller businesses seeking flexible, on-demand legal expertise.

## Key Topics

- on-demand legal services
- attorney network
- business law
- intellectual property
- labor and employment
- business formation
- legal documents
- vetted attorneys
- legal counsel
- contract review

## Core Platform

- [UpCounsel: Expert Legal Services and Free Legal Documents](https://proxy-production.upcounsel.com/): UpCounsel homepage: hire vetted attorneys on-demand for legal services
